texts.zh:
在整个[root.GetSpeciesAdj]历史上，外部亚文化一直如影随形。随着义体增强技术的出现，情况发生了变化：一些边缘群体开始对自己进行大刀阔斧的改造，以至于看起来根本不像是[root.GetSpeciesAdj]。尤其是年轻人，他们对高度定制的[root.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]、3D躯体艺术和其他装饰性附肢的渴望正在拉大代沟。

支持者声称，他们正在拥抱更真实的自我。他们通过放弃[root.GetSpeciesAdj]的同质化维护自己生命的主观能动性。但越来越多的家长和社会专家反对这种观点，他们谴责这些人是要破坏我们社会的恶棍。
texts.en:
Outsider subcultures have existed throughout [root.GetSpeciesAdj] history, but with the advent of cybernetic enhancements the situation has changed: fringe groups have begun altering themselves so radically as to appear non-[root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Youths in particular are straining generation gaps with their lust for heavily customized [root.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural], 3D body art, and other decorative appendages.

Proponents claim they are embracing their truer selves, and that by renouncing [root.GetSpeciesAdj] homogeneity they are simply asserting agency over their own lives. These views are not shared by a growing number of concerned parents and social pundits, who denounce such individuals as miscreants out to ruin our society.

texts.zh: 成千上万的年轻人、活动家和艺术家聚集在一起，呼吁义体强化改造自由。抗议者有的从外表上看来是正常的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，也有的拥有定制肢体、重塑躯体，还有的看起来像是外星人。他们都在声援那些因在义体装饰方面的个人选择而面临歧视的[root.GetAdj]公民。
texts.en: Concerned youths, activists, and artists have gathered in their thousands to demand freedom of cybernetic augmentation. Protestors run the gamut from outwardly typical [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to individuals with custom limbs, reshaped torsos, and other alien-looking forms. All proclaim solidarity with [root.GetAdj] citizens who face discrimination for their personal choices in cybernetic adornment.

tooltips.zh: 我们会继续营造一种集体主义义体氛围。
tooltips.en: We will continue to foster a collectivist approach to cybernetics.

label.zh: 我们应该考虑他们的诉求。

tooltips.zh: 我们将授予个人更多关于义体强化改造的选择自由。
tooltips.en: Individuals will be granted somewhat freer choice over cybernetic augmentation.

texts.zh:
医疗工作者抱怨称，目前治疗那些使用着极端特殊义体强化体的病人时，面临着前所未有的奇怪困难。

这些精心雕刻的个体即使只是一些小毛病，也大多需要使用特殊的治疗措施，如定制工具或剧烈拆卸等。此类干预措施的费用甚至超过了那些未修饰的非[root.GetSpeciesAdj]患者。
texts.en:
Medical workers have raised complaints about the bizarre and unprecedented obstacles they now face when treating patients with radically unique cybernetic augments.

Many of these elaborately-sculpted individuals require special treatment measures such as custom tools or drastic disassembly, even for minor ailments. The costs for such interventions far exceed those associated with unmodified, non-[root.GetSpeciesAdj] patients.

# 激进外表 / Radical Image

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/machine_age_situation_events_1.txt:3637-3890`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- “未来冲击”事件链中段：网络化局势结束后 cyber.500 选出 505–525 之一，约180+随机90天后隐藏事件 cyber.600 从 on_futureshock_chain_work_family_events_list（11个事件，权重各5：工作 610/615/625/655，家庭 805/810/815/820/830/840/855）抽取一个。
  Middle of the "Future Shock" event chain: after the Cyberization situation ends cyber.500 picks one of 505-525; about 180 days (+ random 90) later hidden cyber.600 draws one event from on_futureshock_chain_work_family_events_list (11 events, weight 5 each: work 610/615/625/655, family 805/810/815/820/830/840/855).
- 触发：不是意识集合体，起源不是网络信条/断镣/复仇/食尸者，且未掌握基因定制科技。
  Trigger: not Gestalt Consciousness, origin not Cybernetic Creed / Broken Shackles / Payback / Necrophage, and no Gene Tailoring technology.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 820「激进形象」：a 团结奖励，约一半概率 20+随机20天后 821「激进抗议」；b radical_image 修正，25%概率 40+随机30天后 822「激进体质」（需 radical_image）；c radical_insights（排外者不可选）。
  820 "Radical Image": a unity reward, with about a 50% chance of 821 "Radical Protests" after 20 days (+ random 20); b radical_image modifier, with 25% chance of 822 "Radical Physiology" after 40 days (+ random 30) (needs radical_image); c radical_insights (not for fanatic xenophobes).
- 821：驳回（radical_image_denied，威权有版本）或维护（radical_image_upheld）；822：能量选项或移除 radical_image；其余路径180+随机90天后 cyber.1000。
  821: deny (radical_image_denied, authoritarian variant) or uphold (radical_image_upheld); 822: an energy option or remove radical_image; every path then reaches cyber.1000 after 180 days (+ random 90).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 821 与 822 来自不同选项，互斥。
  821 and 822 come from different options and are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 起源或科技不符合则本事件不出现。
  The event does not appear if origin or technology exclude it.
